chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd, from Jaʿfar, from his father عليهما السلام, who said:

“A person is not stripped in a hadd punishment, nor is he made to be spread out,” meaning stretched out. And he said: “The fornicator is struck in the state in which he is found: if he is found naked, he is struck naked; and if he is found while his clothes are on him, he is struck while his clothes are on him.”

key_terms.الزَّانِي: the fornicator, the one guilty of zina
key_terms.الْحَالِ: the condition or state in which a person is found
key_terms.حَدٍّ: a prescribed legal punishment in Islamic law

ai.seo_question: How should the hadd punishment for zina be administered according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the manner of administering the hadd punishment for zina. It states that the person is not to be stripped or stretched out, and that the punishment is carried out according to the state in which the person is found, whether clothed or unclothed.
